summary.text: Robin Vos is a Republican member of the Wisconsin Assembly representing District 33, based in Rochester, and has been elected to the Assembly since 2004.

paragraphs.text: Vos was born in Burlington, Wisconsin, on July 5, 1968.
He graduated from Burlington High School in 1986 and is listed as attending the University of Wisconsin-Whitewater in 1991.
The Legislature's page lists him as the owner of several small businesses and a former congressional district director and legislative assistant.
It says he was appointed to the University of Wisconsin Board of Regents from 1989 to 1991 and was elected to the Racine County Board from 1994 to 2004.
He is a former president of the National Conference of State Legislatures and chairs the Committee on Assembly Organization.
